title: KNBS national livestock, livestock-product and sugarcane tables, Kenya
source: KNBS National Agriculture Production Report, 2023-24 edition (NAPR 2024: T4.2, T4.4, T6.1-T6.8) and 2024-25 edition (NAPR 2025: T5.3.2, T5.3.5, T7.1-T7.5, T7.7-T7.12)
citation: KNBS. National Agriculture Production Report. Nairobi, Kenya.
license: KNBS official statistics — public; cite KNBS.
method: Deterministic extraction (_sources/napr_build_national.py + napr_annex.py): rows located by printed label / year stub, numbers bound to columns by glyph right edge (rotated tables handled). Gates: completeness (every declared cell filled except cells printed '--' / blank), printed totals = sum of parts (cattle, sheep, goats, hives, meat quantity + value; 60/60 PASS). Cross-edition 2024 vs 2025 differences are reported in _sources/napr_national_gate.csv (KNBS revisions, e.g. 2023 milk 4,568.6 -> 5,242.1 M kg). `value` is as printed in `unit`; `value_base` = value x printed scale in `unit_base`. No number typed by a model.
coverage: National, 2019-2023 (2024 ed) and 2019/2020-2024 (2025 ed): livestock populations by type, hives, milk production/intake + value, meat production + value, slaughter numbers, eggs/honey/wax/hides/skins/wool quantity + value, sugarcane area/harvested/deliveries/yield/farm-gate price, sugar production/imports/exports.
used_by: reference for the county-sum gates in napr_build_livestock.py / napr_build_products.py; national context
